title: Inter Women Lose 3–1 at Real Madrid After a Red Card. Did the Red Decide It? #Shorts
description:
Inter Women played most of the game in Madrid with ten players. We say they lost to the red card, not to Real Madrid.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=79

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Inter Women lost 3–1 to Real Madrid in round five of the Women's Champions League league phase. Real Madrid led when Karolina Vilhjalmsdottir was sent off after a video review in the 41st minute; Michela Cambiaghi tied it in first-half stoppage time, and Real Madrid scored twice late. Source: Inter.it, Nov 18.
CONFIRMED — Inter stay on four points and host Arsenal on December 16 in their last league-phase game, with a place in the knockout rounds still possible. Source: Inter.it, Nov 18.
CONFIRMED — Francesco Pio Esposito scored three goals for Italy during the international break and now has ten in 15 games. Source: Inter.it, Nov 18.
REPORTED — Inter are willing to offer Hakan Çalhanoğlu, whose contract runs to 2027, a new deal not far from his current salary, with a lower fixed part and richer bonuses; talks are still open. Source: Corriere dello Sport via FCInter1908, Nov 19.
NEXT UP — Atalanta vs Inter, Sunday, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET (20:45 CET), Serie A Matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
